entries.en: "I made it meself," the boatman said, patting the little wooden stool.
entries.zh: “这是我自己做的，”船夫说着，拍了拍那张小木凳。

entries.meaningZh: 没有；无〔源自法语，较诙谐或文雅〕
entries.en: We arrived at the picnic sans plates but carrying an enormous cake.
entries.zh: 我们带着一个硕大的蛋糕来野餐，却没带盘子。

entries.en: "Keep thyself warm," the old shepherd whispered to the child in the play.
entries.zh: 剧中，老牧羊人低声对孩子说：“让自己暖和些。”

entries.en: The disputed field lies outwith the boundary marked on this map.
entries.zh: 那块有争议的田地位于这张地图标出的边界之外。

entries.en: "This cloak is thine," the queen told the traveller before opening the gate.
entries.zh: “这件斗篷归你了，”女王对旅人说，然后打开了大门。

entries.en: Dinner chez Nina usually ends with everyone singing around the piano.
entries.zh: 在妮娜家吃晚餐，通常到最后大家都会围着钢琴唱歌。

entries.en: You may give the spare ticket to whomsoever you choose.
entries.zh: 你可以把多出的那张票给你选中的任何人。

entries.en: Whosoever arrives first may choose a seat beside the window.
entries.zh: 不管是谁先到，都可以选一个靠窗的座位。

entries.meaningZh: 从…出来〔out of 的非正式写法〕
entries.en: "Get outta the shed before that shelf falls," shouted my younger brother.
entries.zh: “快从棚子里出来，那个架子要倒了！”我弟弟喊道。

entries.meaningZh: 我自己〔君主等使用单数 we 时〕
entries.en: "We shall inspect the damaged gate ourself," declared the king in the play.
entries.zh: 剧中，国王宣布：“朕将亲自查看受损的大门。”

entries.meaningZh: 自己〔非正式单数反身代词，源标俚语〕
entries.en: Each volunteer could see themself in the photograph beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 每位志愿者都能在入口旁的那张照片上看到自己。

entries.en: "He painted the whole fence hisself," she said, pointing across the yard.
entries.zh: “整道围栏都是他自己刷的，”她指着院子那头说。

entries.meaningZh: 在…面前〔法律用语，源自拉丁语〕
entries.en: The clerk recorded that the hearing took place coram Judge Ellis.
entries.zh: 书记员记录说，听证会在埃利斯法官面前举行。

entries.en: The old solicitor sent another letter anenst the disputed boundary.
entries.zh: 那位老律师又寄来一封关于争议边界的信。

entries.en: Her final note anent the missing portrait was tucked inside the catalogue.
entries.zh: 她最后一张关于失踪肖像的便条夹在目录里。

entries.en: "Keep the cart anigh the wall," the farmer called to his son.
entries.zh: “让车靠着墙走，”农夫向儿子喊道。

entries.en: According to the timetable, our train leaves after the last bus arrives.
entries.zh: 根据时刻表，我们的火车在末班公交车到达之后发车。

entries.en: The rehearsal went according to plan until a dog wandered onto the stage.
entries.zh: 彩排一直按计划进行，直到一只狗溜达到了舞台上。

entries.en: A snowstorm in midsummer seemed almost against nature to the villagers.
entries.zh: 在村民看来，盛夏下暴风雪几乎违背了自然规律。

entries.en: A cyclist reached the narrow bridge ahead of our bus.
entries.zh: 一名骑车人赶在我们的公交车之前到达了那座窄桥。

entries.meaningZh: 到处；杂乱地〔英式非正式用语〕
entries.en: After the parcel burst, tiny beads rolled all over the shop.
entries.zh: 包裹裂开后，小珠子滚得到处都是。

entries.en: Please return the borrowed camera along with its spare battery.
entries.zh: 请把借来的相机连同备用电池一起归还。

entries.en: Apart from a loose handle, the suitcase survived the journey intact.
entries.zh: 除了一个把手松了，这只手提箱在旅途中完好无损。

entries.en: The choir as a whole sounded confident despite a few hesitant entrances.
entries.zh: 尽管有几处起唱有些犹豫，合唱团整体听起来很自信。

entries.en: We sold thirty tickets this morning, as against twelve yesterday morning.
entries.zh: 我们今天上午卖了三十张票，而昨天上午卖了十二张。

entries.en: The kitten looked pleased as anything with its stolen ribbon.
entries.zh: 小猫偷到了一条丝带，显得得意极了。

entries.en: The muddy footprints continued as far as the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 泥脚印一直延伸到厨房门口。

entries.en: As for the broken clock, we decided to leave it above the fireplace.
entries.zh: 至于那座坏钟，我们决定仍把它留在壁炉上方。

entries.en: As from tomorrow, rehearsals will take place in the smaller hall.
entries.zh: 从明天起，排练将在较小的大厅里进行。

entries.en: As of this morning, only three costumes still needed buttons.
entries.zh: 截至今天上午，只有三套服装还需要缝纽扣。

entries.en: The audience rose as one when the elderly dancer returned to the stage.
entries.zh: 那位年迈的舞者重返舞台时，观众们齐刷刷地站了起来。

entries.en: We need a quiet room, as opposed to a large one.
entries.zh: 我们需要的是一间安静的房间，而不是一间大房间。

entries.en: As regards the missing chairs, the caretaker has promised to search the attic.
entries.zh: 关于那些不见了的椅子，管理员已答应去阁楼找找。

entries.en: The shed is now a workshop and should be treated as such.
entries.zh: 这个棚子现在是工作间，应当按工作间来使用和对待。

entries.en: We received no instructions as to the position of the extra table.
entries.zh: 关于加出来的那张桌子该摆在哪里，我们没有收到任何指示。

entries.en: The cupboard held sketchbooks as well as several boxes of old photographs.
entries.zh: 橱柜里除了素描本，还有几盒旧照片。

entries.en: Without a working microphone, the quietest speaker was at a disadvantage.
entries.zh: 没有可用的麦克风，声音最小的那位发言者就处于不利地位。

entries.en: We watched the nervous pony at a distance until it settled down.
entries.zh: 我们隔着一段距离看着那匹紧张的小马，直到它平静下来。

entries.en: An experienced carpenter could spot the crooked shelf at a glance.
entries.zh: 有经验的木匠一眼就能看出那个架子歪了。

entries.en: At a guess, the box contains enough tiles for half the kitchen.
entries.zh: 估计这箱瓷砖够铺半个厨房。

entries.en: Finding herself at a loose end, Leah offered to mend the torn curtains.
entries.zh: 莉娅闲着没事，便提出帮忙缝补破窗帘。

entries.en: Morale was at a low ebb after three rehearsals without a single complete scene.
entries.zh: 接连排练了三次，却连一场完整的戏都没排完，大家的士气十分低落。

entries.en: At a minimum, we need a lamp and two chairs for this scene.
entries.zh: 这一场戏至少需要一盏灯和两把椅子。

entries.meaningZh: 必要时；在紧要关头〔英式用语〕
entries.en: At a pinch, the folding table could serve as an extra desk.
entries.zh: 必要时，那张折叠桌可以充当额外的书桌。

entries.en: Dry storage space was at a premium in the crowded boathouse.
entries.zh: 在那间拥挤的船屋里，干燥的储物空间十分宝贵。

entries.en: The repair restored the violin's sound, but at a price we could barely afford.
entries.zh: 这次修理恢复了小提琴的音色，但费用高得我们几乎负担不起。

entries.en: The new bridge shortened our walk by twenty minutes at a stroke.
entries.zh: 新桥一下子让我们的步行时间缩短了二十分钟。

entries.en: Someone had wedged the cupboard at an angle beneath the stairs.
entries.zh: 有人把那个橱柜斜着塞在了楼梯下面。

entries.en: A small fishing boat lay at anchor beyond the harbour wall.
entries.zh: 一艘小渔船抛锚停泊在港口防波堤外。

entries.meaningZh: 无论如何；不惜任何代价
entries.en: The exhausted climber refused to continue at any price.
entries.zh: 那位精疲力竭的登山者无论如何都不肯继续前进。

entries.en: The two rival bakers were at daggers drawn over the disputed recipe.
entries.zh: 两位竞争的面包师为那份有争议的配方闹得势不两立。

entries.en: In the novel, the rescued sailor is at death's door when the doctor arrives.
entries.zh: 小说中，医生到达时，那名获救的水手已生命垂危。

entries.en: A joke about the missing umbrella soon put the shy guest at ease.
entries.zh: 一个关于失踪雨伞的笑话很快让那位害羞的客人放松了下来。

entries.en: At first, I mistook the distant bells for someone practising the piano.
entries.zh: 起初，我把远处的钟声误当成有人在练钢琴。

entries.en: The costume team was working at full stretch before opening night.
entries.zh: 首演前，服装组正全力以赴地工作。

entries.en: The motor roared at full throttle as the boat pulled away from the jetty.
entries.zh: 船驶离码头时，马达全速轰鸣。

entries.en: Our dog raced at full tilt towards the open garden gate.
entries.zh: 我们的狗全速冲向敞开的花园大门。

entries.en: The film opens with a shopkeeper being forced at gunpoint to open a safe.
entries.zh: 影片开场，一名店主被人用枪逼着打开保险柜。

entries.en: Small wooden benches stood at intervals along the winding path.
entries.zh: 蜿蜒的小路沿途每隔一段距离就有一张小木凳。

entries.en: The colour of the curtains was not the point at issue.
entries.zh: 窗帘的颜色并不是争论的焦点。

entries.en: In the thriller, the courier is forced at knifepoint into an empty warehouse.
entries.zh: 惊悚片中，送件人被人持刀逼进一间空仓库。

entries.en: After the exhibition closed, I felt at loose ends without my daily painting routine.
entries.zh: 展览结束后，没有了每天画画的惯例，我觉得无所适从。

entries.en: The old pipes make strange knocking sounds at night.
entries.zh: 那些旧管道在夜里会发出奇怪的敲击声。

entries.en: A loose roof tile put everyone using the narrow passage at risk.
entries.zh: 一片松动的屋瓦让每个经过那条窄通道的人都面临危险。

entries.en: I heard the story at second hand and cannot remember who first told it.
entries.zh: 这个故事是我间接听来的，我不记得最初是谁讲的了。

entries.meaningZh: 在接到通知后的短时间内
entries.en: Can you find another pianist at short notice for tomorrow's rehearsal?
entries.zh: 你能临时另找一位钢琴师来参加明天的排练吗？

entries.en: The backstage area was at sixes and sevens after the hurried costume change.
entries.zh: 匆忙换装后，后台一片混乱。

entries.en: We found a room near the station, and a quiet one at that.
entries.zh: 我们在车站附近找到了一间房，而且还是一间安静的房间。

entries.meaningZh: 即使在最有利的情况下
entries.en: The attic is gloomy at the best of times, even with both lamps on.
entries.zh: 阁楼即使在最好的时候也很昏暗，哪怕两盏灯都开着。

entries.en: The caretaker hurried at the double to shut the gate before the goats escaped.
entries.zh: 管理员赶忙快步跑去关门，免得山羊逃出去。

entries.term: at the drop of a hat
entries.en: My father's younger brother will abandon his gardening at the drop of a hat for a chess game.
entries.zh: 只要能下一盘棋，我叔叔就会毫不迟疑地放下园艺活儿。

entries.en: The new shelves provided storage at the expense of valuable floor space.
entries.zh: 新架子增加了储物空间，却占去了宝贵的地面空间。

entries.en: The detective in the story suffers a humiliating defeat at the hands of a child.
entries.zh: 故事中的侦探败在一个孩子手下，十分丢脸。

entries.en: Please leave the keys with the caretaker by noon at the latest.
entries.zh: 请最迟在中午之前把钥匙交给管理员。

entries.en: Without a spare sail, we were at the mercy of the shifting wind.
entries.zh: 没有备用帆，我们只能任由变化不定的风摆布。

entries.en: The shop is closed at the moment while we move the heavy cabinets.
entries.zh: 我们正在搬动沉重的柜子，商店此刻暂停营业。

entries.en: At the outset, each player received a map and a sealed envelope.
entries.zh: 开始时，每个玩家都得到了一张地图和一个封好的信封。

entries.en: The repairs should take two days at the outside, the carpenter assured us.
entries.zh: 木匠向我们保证，修理最多需要两天。

entries.en: At the risk of sounding ungrateful, I must ask for a smaller portion.
entries.zh: 冒着显得不领情的风险，我还是得请你少给我盛一点。

entries.en: The paper lantern collapsed at the touch of a curious child's hand.
entries.zh: 一个好奇的孩子用手一碰，那盏纸灯笼就瘪了。

entries.en: At this rate, we will finish the entire jigsaw before dinner.
entries.zh: 照这样下去，我们晚饭前就能拼完整幅拼图。

entries.en: Her sketch was at variance with the dimensions written in my notebook.
entries.zh: 她的草图与我笔记本上写的尺寸不符。

entries.en: Keep the wet paintings away from the open window.
entries.zh: 把那些未干的画放得离敞开的窗户远些。

entries.en: Barring another broken wheel, the cart should reach the farm before sunset.
entries.zh: 除非再坏一个轮子，这辆车应该能在日落前到达农场。

entries.en: We moved the puppet show indoors because of the strong wind.
entries.zh: 因为风很大，我们把木偶戏移到了室内。

entries.en: The innocent gardener spends several chapters behind bars in the mystery novel.
entries.zh: 在那本推理小说的好几章中，无辜的园丁都被关在狱中。

entries.en: The judges discussed the final two paintings behind closed doors.
entries.zh: 评委们关起门来讨论最后两幅画，不对外公开。

entries.en: Nina was hurt to learn that her friends had changed the plan behind her back.
entries.zh: 妮娜得知朋友们背着她改了计划，感到很受伤。

entries.en: The novel's missing heir was already below ground when the letter arrived.
entries.zh: 信送到时，小说中那位失踪的继承人已经入土了。

entries.en: The second batch of biscuits was below par, with burnt edges and soggy centres.
entries.zh: 第二批饼干质量不达标，边缘焦了，里面却湿软。

entries.en: A faint smell of bread rose from the kitchen below stairs.
entries.zh: 一股淡淡的面包香从地下室的厨房飘了上来。

entries.en: Between ourselves, I would rather keep the old piano than sell it.
entries.zh: 私下里说，比起卖掉那架旧钢琴，我更愿意留下它。

entries.term: between the devil and the deep blue sea
entries.en: Refusing either invitation would offend someone, leaving me between the devil and the deep blue sea.
entries.zh: 拒绝任何一方的邀请都会得罪人，让我进退两难。

entries.meaningZh: 只限于我俩之间；私下说
entries.en: Between you and me, the surprise party was not much of a surprise.
entries.zh: 咱俩私下说，那场惊喜派对其实没让人感到多意外。

entries.en: The cellar was cluttered beyond belief with broken chairs and empty jars.
entries.zh: 地窖里堆满了破椅子和空罐子，凌乱得令人难以置信。

entries.en: By the time she regretted the accusation, the letter was posted and beyond recall.
entries.zh: 等她后悔作出那项指控时，信已经寄出，无法挽回了。

entries.en: Fresh paint and new windows had changed the cottage beyond recognition.
entries.zh: 新刷的油漆和新换的窗户让那间小屋变得认不出来了。

entries.meaningZh: 相差很多〔英式非正式用语〕
entries.en: Our best runner did not win the race, not by a long chalk.
entries.zh: 我们最好的跑步选手没能赢下比赛，而且还差得远呢。

entries.en: By all accounts, the missing cat has been eating breakfast at several different houses.
entries.zh: 据大家所说，那只失踪的猫一直在好几户人家吃早饭。

entries.en: By all appearances, the dusty suitcase had not been opened for years.
entries.zh: 从外表看，那个落满灰尘的手提箱已经多年没有打开过了。

entries.en: If by any chance the parcel arrives early, please put it in the shed.
entries.zh: 万一包裹提前到了，请把它放进棚子里。

entries.en: We visited the little costume collection by appointment on a rainy afternoon.
entries.zh: 一个下雨的下午，我们按预约参观了那个小型服装收藏馆。

entries.en: The novel's hero is a prince by birth but grows up among travelling actors.
entries.zh: 小说主人公生来是王子，却在巡回演出的演员中长大。

entries.en: By comparison with the draughty attic, the tiny kitchen felt wonderfully warm.
entries.zh: 与漏风的阁楼相比，小厨房显得暖和极了。

entries.en: The first sketch was crowded with detail; the second, by contrast, used only a few lines.
entries.zh: 第一张素描细节繁多；相比之下，第二张只用了寥寥几笔。

entries.en: We borrowed a rehearsal room by courtesy of the village school.
entries.zh: 承蒙村里学校的好意，我们借到了一间排练室。

entries.en: Our team won by default when the other players failed to appear.
entries.zh: 对方队员没有到场，我们队因此不战而胜。

entries.en: By degrees, the muddy water in the jar became clear.
entries.zh: 罐子里的泥水渐渐变清了。

entries.en: By dint of patient practice, Theo learned to balance the tray on one hand.
entries.zh: 凭借耐心练习，西奥学会了用一只手平稳地托住托盘。

entries.en: My younger sister picked out the unfamiliar melody by ear on the old electronic keyboard.
entries.zh: 我妹妹凭听觉在旧电子琴上摸索着弹出了那首不熟悉的旋律。

entries.en: The villain intends to obtain the missing jewel by fair means or foul.
entries.zh: 反派打算不择手段地弄到那颗失踪的宝石。

entries.en: By force of habit, I reached for a light switch that was no longer there.
entries.zh: 出于习惯，我伸手去摸一个早已不在那里的电灯开关。

entries.en: His excuse was too elaborate by half to sound convincing.
entries.zh: 他的借口编得太复杂，反而显得不可信。

entries.en: In the story, every household must keep a lantern by law.
entries.zh: 故事中，法律规定每户人家都必须备有一盏灯。

entries.en: We lifted the heavy lid by means of a rope threaded through its handle.
entries.zh: 我们借助一根穿过把手的绳子抬起了沉重的盖子。

entries.en: The first attempt was by no manner of means a complete failure.
entries.zh: 第一次尝试绝非彻底失败。

entries.en: The old chest was difficult to move by reason of its enormous weight.
entries.zh: 那只旧箱子十分沉重，因此很难搬动。

entries.en: I knew the violin maker by reputation before visiting her crowded workshop.
entries.zh: 在拜访那位制琴师拥挤的工作室之前，我已听说过她的名声。

entries.en: A gardener by the name of Ellis helped us identify the damaged tree.
entries.zh: 一位名叫埃利斯的园丁帮我们辨认了那棵受损的树。

entries.en: A larger sail catches more wind; by the same token, it is harder to control.
entries.zh: 更大的帆能兜住更多的风；出于同样的原因，它也更难控制。

entries.en: The story was by turns funny and unsettling, keeping us awake long after midnight.
entries.zh: 这个故事时而好笑，时而令人不安，让我们过了午夜很久仍睡不着。

entries.en: She could reach the top shelf by virtue of her height.
entries.zh: 由于个子高，她够得着最上面的架子。

entries.en: Send the parcel to me care of my elder sister while I am away.
entries.zh: 我不在时，请把包裹寄给我姐姐，由她转交给我。

entries.en: Compared to our old tent, this one feels like a palace.
entries.zh: 与我们的旧帐篷相比，这顶简直像座宫殿。

entries.en: The blue fabric feels rough compared with the green sample.
entries.zh: 与绿色样品相比，蓝色布料摸起来很粗糙。

entries.en: The children built a cardboard castle, complete with a drawbridge and a tiny flag.
entries.zh: 孩子们用纸板做了一座城堡，还配上了吊桥和一面小旗。

entries.en: I found a handwritten note concerning the missing violin inside the empty case.
entries.zh: 我在空琴盒里发现了一张关于失踪小提琴的手写便条。

entries.en: Considering the narrow doorway, we were lucky to get the sofa inside.
entries.zh: 考虑到门口那么窄，我们能把沙发搬进去已经很幸运了。

entries.en: Contrary to my expectations, the repaired clock ran quietly all night.
entries.zh: 与我的预期相反，修好的钟整夜都安静地走着。

entries.en: All that careful rehearsal went down the drain when we forgot the costumes.
entries.zh: 我们忘带了服装，之前精心进行的排练全都白费了。

entries.meaningZh: 完全地；处处〔非正式用语〕
entries.en: The committee rejected our proposal right down the line, from its budget to its design.
entries.zh: 委员会把我们的提案从预算到设计全盘否决了。

entries.en: She checked every part of the costume, down to the smallest button.
entries.zh: 她检查了服装的每个部分，连最小的纽扣也没有放过。

entries.en: The delay was due to a missing key, not a broken lock.
entries.zh: 延误是因为钥匙不见了，而不是锁坏了。

entries.en: The stage was empty except for a single chair beneath the spotlight.
entries.zh: 舞台上空无一物，只有聚光灯下的一把椅子。

entries.en: Excepting the heavy oak table, we moved every piece of furniture upstairs.
entries.zh: 除了那张沉重的橡木桌，我们把所有家具都搬到了楼上。

entries.en: The tour lasted three hours, excluding the time we spent waiting for the bus.
entries.zh: 这次游览持续了三个小时，不包括我们等公交车的时间。

entries.en: Let's eat outside for a change instead of squeezing into the kitchen.
entries.zh: 我们换个地方到外面吃吧，别再挤在厨房里了。

entries.en: For all his confidence, the young actor kept checking the script.
entries.zh: 尽管那位年轻演员很自信，他仍不停地查看剧本。

entries.en: For better or worse, we have painted the entire kitchen purple.
entries.zh: 不论结果好坏，我们已经把整个厨房刷成紫色了。

entries.en: She carried the cracked bowl in both hands for fear of dropping it.
entries.zh: 她生怕把那只裂了的碗摔下去，便用双手端着。

entries.en: A row of small boats for hire rocked gently beside the wooden pier.
entries.zh: 一排供出租的小船在木码头旁轻轻摇晃。

entries.en: We wore matching paper crowns for laughs during the long train journey.
entries.zh: 长途坐火车时，我们为了逗乐，戴上了款式相同的纸王冠。

entries.en: For my part, I would rather repair the old chairs than replace them.
entries.zh: 就我而言，我宁愿修好那些旧椅子，也不愿换掉它们。

entries.en: We cannot rehearse here; for one thing, the ceiling is too low.
entries.zh: 我们不能在这里排练；首先，天花板就太低了。

entries.en: The customer tried the riding boots for size before asking about their price.
entries.zh: 顾客先试了试那双马靴的尺码，然后才询问价格。

entries.en: We kept the main garden path clear for the benefit of visitors with pushchairs.
entries.zh: 为了方便推婴儿车的游客，我们让花园里的主路保持畅通。

entries.en: She meant it for the best when she secretly repaired his battered hat.
entries.zh: 她偷偷修补他那顶破旧的帽子，本是出于好意。

entries.en: The mood in the workshop changed for the better after the missing tools turned up.
entries.zh: 失踪的工具找到后，工作间里的气氛好转了。

entries.en: He checked the empty cupboard for the last time before returning the keys.
entries.zh: 交还钥匙前，他最后检查了一次空橱柜。

entries.en: For the present, we are keeping the spare costumes in the dining room.
entries.zh: 我们暂时把备用服装放在餐厅里。

entries.en: The chair asked everyone to state their name for the record before the meeting began.
entries.zh: 会议开始前，主持人请大家报上姓名，以便记录。

entries.en: We left the door unlocked for the sake of the late arrivals.
entries.zh: 为了方便迟到的人，我们没有锁门。

entries.en: The weather took a turn for the worse just as we unfolded the picnic blanket.
entries.zh: 我们刚展开野餐毯，天气就变坏了。

entries.en: The half-built puppet lay unfinished for want of a suitable piece of cloth.
entries.zh: 由于缺少合适的布料，那只做了一半的木偶还没有完成。

entries.en: From a distance, the sheep on the hillside looked like scattered stones.
entries.zh: 从远处看，山坡上的羊就像散落的石头。

entries.en: From all accounts, the new caretaker can repair almost anything in the building.
entries.zh: 据大家所说，新管理员几乎能修好楼里的任何东西。

entries.en: From force of habit, she folded the newspaper before handing it to me.
entries.zh: 出于习惯，她先把报纸折起来，再递给我。

entries.en: I drew the old garden from memory and forgot the little shed.
entries.zh: 我凭记忆画出了那座旧花园，却忘了那个小棚子。

entries.en: The lamp swung from side to side as the carriage crossed the uneven bridge.
entries.zh: 马车驶过凹凸不平的桥面时，灯左右摇摆。

entries.en: The crew scrubbed the little boat from stem to stern before the visitors arrived.
entries.zh: 访客到来前，船员们把小船从船头到船尾彻底擦洗了一遍。

entries.term: from the cradle to the grave
entries.en: The novel follows its restless heroine from the cradle to the grave.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了那位不安于现状的女主人公从出生到去世的一生。

entries.en: From the outset, I knew the huge wardrobe would not fit through our door.
entries.zh: 从一开始，我就知道那个大衣柜过不了我们家的门。

entries.en: In the tale, villagers have guarded the mysterious well from time immemorial.
entries.zh: 故事中，村民们自古以来就守护着那口神秘的井。

entries.en: We searched the cupboard from top to bottom without finding the missing cup.
entries.zh: 我们把橱柜从上到下找了个遍，却没找到丢失的杯子。

entries.en: After crawling beneath the stage, Sam was covered in dust from top to toe.
entries.zh: 从舞台底下爬过之后，萨姆从头到脚都是灰。

entries.en: In the detective story, the hotel manager works hand in glove with the jewel thieves.
entries.zh: 侦探故事中，旅馆经理与珠宝窃贼相互勾结。

entries.en: The family celebrated the shop's anniversary in a big way, inviting the whole street.
entries.zh: 那家人大张旗鼓地庆祝商店周年，邀请了整条街的人。

entries.en: Promising the same room to two visitors left the host in a cleft stick.
entries.zh: 主人把同一间房许给了两位访客，结果陷入了两难。

entries.en: She left in a huff after we laughed at her enormous umbrella.
entries.zh: 我们嘲笑她那把硕大的雨伞，她便气冲冲地走了。

entries.en: I'll fetch a clean towel and be back in a jiffy.
entries.zh: 我去拿条干净毛巾，马上就回来。

entries.en: The garden became our classroom, in a manner of speaking, during the painting course.
entries.zh: 可以说，上绘画课期间，那座花园成了我们的教室。

entries.meaningZh: 必要时；在紧要关头〔美式用语〕
entries.en: In a pinch, a folded blanket can serve as a seat cushion.
entries.zh: 必要时，折起来的毯子可以当坐垫用。

entries.en: The drummer dropped a stick three times in a row during rehearsal.
entries.zh: 排练时，鼓手接连三次掉了鼓槌。

entries.en: In a sense, repairing the old boat brought the whole family together again.
entries.zh: 从某种意义上说，修理旧船让全家人又团结到了一起。

entries.en: He was in a state after discovering that his passport was missing.
entries.zh: 他发现护照不见后，急得不知如何是好。

entries.en: Maya was in a stew about the cake she had forgotten to collect.
entries.zh: 玛雅忘了去取蛋糕，正为此发愁。

entries.en: The porter arrived in a sweat after carrying our cases up four flights of stairs.
entries.zh: 搬运工提着我们的箱子爬了四段楼梯，来到时已是一身大汗。
